about: What's new in Tabi, newest first. Every release that changes package.json's version adds an entry here in the same pull request (test/changelog.test.mjs checks). Write changes for the people using the app, one short sentence each.

changes: The All days button in the itinerary no longer gets cut off at the edge of the screen.
Pull a place card down by its title as well as the little bar at the top.
After pulling a card part way down and letting go, its close button works on the first tap.
The developer console stays steady while live updates arrive: no more flicker, jumping, or text you've typed being cleared.
Tabi now tells you when it has been updated, with a link to what's new.
Settings has a Changelog with the latest updates.
Pinch a picture or GIF in the group chat to open it full screen, then pinch, double-tap or drag to zoom.
Tap a GIF in the chat to open it full screen.
On phones, the app no longer zooms like a web page when you pinch or double-tap. The map still zooms.
Pinch, double-tap and drag to zoom into trip photos and chat photos.
Places on the map glide together when they group and spread out when they split, instead of popping.
New Satellite view in the map layers menu, with aerial photos of Japan under the map's roads and labels.
Buildings show in 3D in dark mode too.
iPhone: turning the phone to landscape and back no longer leaves text too big or taps landing in the wrong place.
Android app: keeps sharing your location while you're standing still, and starts again as soon as you turn sharing on.
Android app: new versions of the app can install in place from Tabi.
